reply_text:
I found two 2024 predictions that aren't already recorded and that meet all four conditions. Both come from pages I opened.

- **Dwarkesh Patel podcast, 18 April 2024:** Zuckerberg said Meta hoped to release the 405-billion-parameter Llama 3 model "later in the year" and expected it to lead several benchmarks.
- **Second-quarter earnings call, 31 July 2024:** he said Llama 4 was being aimed at being "the most advanced in the industry next year." This is the same claim as the recorded open-letter file from 23 July, said again on a new occasion, so I've marked it as already recorded.

The same call also repeated the recorded claim that Meta AI would be the most used assistant by the end of 2024.

**Gaps you should know about:**
- **Cut-off transcripts:** two pages came back incomplete. The Dwarkesh transcript stops at about the 23-minute mark, so the later sections on energy limits and an "intelligence explosion" went unread. The Acquired transcript stops at about 20 minutes. A complete copy of either could hold more dated claims.
- **Page openings:** I used all six, but two were spent re-opening the same two pages after a parsing mistake. In effect I read four pages: the Dwarkesh transcript, the Acquired transcript, and the first- and second-quarter call transcripts.
- **Not opened:** Zuckerberg's 6 December 2024 Instagram post (Llama 3.3) apparently says Llama 4 comes "next year," but I saw that only in news snippets. The 18 January 2024 Verge interview and AGI video, the July 2024 Jensen Huang talk and the Rowan Cheung interview were also not opened. I've listed none of these as candidates.
- **Left out on purpose:**
  - The claim that training Llama 4 needs almost 10 times Llama 3's compute is a spending forecast.
  - "Building the leading AI… is likely going to take several years" (first-quarter call) is undated and not about AGI.
  - Two remarks that smart AI will now come before holographic AR glasses (second-quarter call and Acquired) give no date and don't clearly concern AGI, so I left them out of `undated` too.
